crossRefs.note: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the…
Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down…
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

parallels.note: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”

translations.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
translations.bsb: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
translations.kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness
translations.asv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
